Definition: Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia
BiblicalUsage: Hazor is the great northern city, head of all the kingdoms of Canaan, whose king Jabin gathers the northern kings against Joshua. Joshua takes it and burns it, and centuries later Solomon rebuilds it as one of his fortified cities.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hazor shows both sides of God's dealing with a city: taken and burned under Joshua, then rebuilt under Solomon. The same stones serve judgement and then serve the kingdom.
